purpose: Follow-up robustness check on the single standout cell from H017's 54-cell sweep (MCL, 30min, fast=10/slow=30, threshold=0.5%) -- full cost scenarios, long/short decomposition, neighboring-parameter stability, and a HAC significance re-check, before deciding whether it merits any elevated confidence.

long_short_decomposition_base_scenario.note: reasonably balanced -- not a one-sided beta-driven result like H012's original MBT->MCL finding

neighboring_parameter_stability_30min_th.note: all 3 neighboring pairs are POSITIVE and form a smooth hump peaking at 10/30 -- NOT an isolated spike (H002's own reject criterion for a parameter optimum)

multiple_comparisons_caveat.reasoning: This cell is the BEST of 54 tested (3 instruments x 3 timeframes x 3 MA pairs x 2 thresholds). A naive |t|>1.96 threshold is calibrated for a SINGLE pre-registered test, not the winner of a 54-way search. A simple Bonferroni correction (alpha=0.05/54) requires roughly |t|>3.3-3.5 to be trustworthy. The naive t=2.11 does NOT clear that bar. Some HAC-adjusted lags (3.36, 3.43, 3.78) marginally do, but HAC estimation on n=20 (below this project's 100-trade floor) is itself less reliable at small n (same caution already flagged in H015's MES 20d/non-overlapping cell), so leaning on the HAC number alone to clear the corrected bar would be cherry-picking the favorable cut.

conclusion: PROMISING LEAD, NOT a confirmed finding. Genuinely reassuring signs (cost-scenario stability, balanced long/short, smooth neighboring-parameter response) distinguish this from a pure overfit artifact, but the multiple-comparisons correction this result needs (as the winner of a 54-cell search) is not clearly cleared. Needs true out-of-sample confirmation on a held-out period, which this IBKR connector cannot currently provide for MCL at 30min resolution (capped at ~66 RTH days total, already fully used). Recorded as provisional, lower confidence than H009's MCL intraday leg (a single pre-registered test, not a search winner).
